title: Dullahan Artisan
author: Icy_Yak_702
selftext:
I made a free tool ([Apache-2.0 license](https://github.com/jayzone80/DullahanArtisan#Apache-2.0-1-ov-file)) to help the LLM create game art!

To many features to describe here. but check it out!

[Dullahan Artisan](https://github.com/jayzone80/DullahanArtisan)

I hope it is of help!

comments.author: Icy_Yak_702
comments.body: A fun idea i had! the DSL file for the spaceship is 33 kb (10 kb zipped), thats around 380x compression! If you add the asset build functions to your project and build the assets direct to memory, its also way faster than loading the model from disk. it almost feel like a demo scene hack!
